newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI STOCKS SEEN FALLING, AWAITING IMF LOAN TALKS.
newsitem.headline: THAI STOCKS SEEN FALLING, AWAITING IMF LOAN TALKS.

text.p: Thai stock investors would likely be sidelined on Monday by international talks on a rescue loan package for Thailand in Tokyo, brokers said.

"Short-term market sentiment remains weak. Investors are waiting to hear about Thailand-IMF talks which have started in Tokyo. Most retailers are expected to stay away enjoying a long holiday as the market is closed tomorrow," said a broker.
The bourse will be closed on Tuesday for the Queen Sirikit's birthday.
